``` {r}
simulations <- 100000

mc_sim_pathless <- function(S, T, sigma, r, q = 0) {
Z <- rnorm(simulations)
return(S * exp((r - q - sigma^2/2)*T + sigma*sqrt(T)*Z))
}
```

``` {r}
mc_european_call <- function(S, K, T, sigma, r, q = 0) {
  paths <- mc_sim_pathless(S, T, sigma, r, q)
  returns <- pmax(paths - K, 0)
  return((sum(returns) / simulations) * exp(-r * T))
}

mc_european_put <- function(S, K, T, sigma, r, q = 0) {
  paths <- mc_sim_pathless(S, T, sigma, r, q)
  returns <- pmax(K - paths, 0)
  return((sum(returns) / simulations) * exp(-r * T))
}
```

``` {r}
mc_sim_pathed <- function(S, T, sigma, r, q = 0) {
  steps <- round(T * 252)
  Z <- matrix(rnorm(simulations * steps), nrow = simulations, ncol = steps)
  dt <- 1 / 252
  transformation <- (r - q - sigma^2/2) * dt + sigma * sqrt(dt) * Z
  #return(S * exp(transformation))
  return(S * exp(t(apply(transformation, 1, cumsum))))
}
```

``` {r}
S <- 100
K <- 110
T <- 1
sigma <- 0.3
r <- 0.08
q <- 0
```

``` {r}
mc_american_call <- function(S, K, T, sigma, r, q = 0) {
  paths <- mc_sim_pathed(S, T, sigma, r, q)
  steps <- round(T * 252)
  dt <- 1/252

  CF <- pmax(paths[, steps] - K, 0)

  for(step in (steps-1):1) {
    x_raw <- paths[, step]
    x <- x_raw / K

    itm_mask <- x_raw > K

    if (sum(itm_mask) < 100) next

    y <- exp(-r * dt) * CF[itm_mask]
    y_positive <- y > 0

    if (sum(y_positive) < 100) next

    X <- cbind(1, x[itm_mask][y_positive], 
               x[itm_mask][y_positive]^2, 
               x[itm_mask][y_positive]^3)
    y_use <- y[y_positive]
    beta <- coef(lm(y_use ~ X - 1))

    X_all <- cbind(1, x, x^2, x^3)
    continuation <- X_all %*% beta
    continuation <- pmax(continuation, 0)

    exercise <- pmax(x_raw - K, 0)
    exercise_now <- exercise > continuation

    CF[exercise_now] <- exercise[exercise_now]
    CF[!exercise_now] <- exp(-r * dt) * CF[!exercise_now]
  }

  return(mean(CF))
}
```

``` {r}
# === Validation ===
library(fOptions)

S <- 100
K <- 110
T <- 1
sigma <- 0.3
r <- 0.08
q <- 0

cat("=== European Call ===\n")
bin_euro_call <- CRRBinomialTreeOption(
  TypeFlag = "ce", S = S, X = K, Time = T, r = r,
  b = r - q, sigma = sigma, n = 500
)@price
mc_euro_call <- mc_european_call(S, K, T, sigma, r, q)
cat("Binomial Tree:", bin_euro_call, "\n")
cat("Monte Carlo:  ", mc_euro_call, "\n")
cat("Difference:   ", abs(bin_euro_call - mc_euro_call), "\n\n")

cat("=== European Put ===\n")
bin_euro_put <- CRRBinomialTreeOption(
  TypeFlag = "pe", S = S, X = K, Time = T, r = r,
  b = r - q, sigma = sigma, n = 500
)@price
mc_euro_put <- mc_european_put(S, K, T, sigma, r, q)
cat("Binomial Tree:", bin_euro_put, "\n")
cat("Monte Carlo:  ", mc_euro_put, "\n")
cat("Difference:   ", abs(bin_euro_put - mc_euro_put), "\n\n")

cat("=== American Call ===\n")
bin_am_call <- CRRBinomialTreeOption(
  TypeFlag = "ca", S = S, X = K, Time = T, r = r,
  b = r - q, sigma = sigma, n = 500
)@price
mc_am_call <- mc_american_call(S, K, T, sigma, r, q)
cat("Binomial Tree:", bin_am_call, "\n")
cat("Monte Carlo:  ", mc_am_call, "\n")
cat("Difference:   ", abs(bin_am_call - mc_am_call), "\n")
```
